| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Attribute** `attribute` | Diameter | Diameter, Area | The diameter is the longer side of the bounding box of a component, as scikit-image measures it. The area is its number of pixels. |
| **Threshold** `threshold` | 8 | 1 to 10000 | Components whose attribute is below this are removed, in pixels across for the diameter or pixels for the area. scikit-image uses 8 for the diameter. |
| **Neighbors** `connectivity` | 8 (sides and corners) | 8 (sides and corners), 4 (sides only) | Which neighbors join a component. scikit-image uses 4, its connectivity 1. 8 is our choice, as for connected-component labeling. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only, Color only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
